name: harness
description: Execution harness for AI-assisted repository work. Enforces plan-develop-verify-close loops with acceptance ledgers, Iron Law debugging, and tiered learning.

features._doc: v1 dual-runtime opt-in model: plugin-codex/ lives outside this marketplace source path (root .claude-plugin/marketplace.json points at './plugin' only, not './'), so 'claude plugin marketplace update harness' will NOT surprise Claude users with a sibling tree. Codex users opt in explicitly via 'codex plugin marketplace add plugin-codex/' (see README.codex.md). The codex_enabled flag is reserved for future config-driven activation; in v1 the structural separation IS the opt-out.
